---
title: "RH Stadium Spectrum Analysis"
---

## Overview

This site summarizes longitudinal RF spectrum measurements collected around the stadium environment.

The goal is to document observed spectral activity, compare activity across distributed nodes, and relate emissions to known event-time wireless systems when possible.

## Pages

- **1920–1930 MHz:** Candidate Riedel Bolero / DECT-like intercom activity.
- **5.8 GHz Links:** Candidate video or WaveCentral-style links near the football event window.
- **Temporal PSD:** Time-evolving PSD views across nodes.
